data.voice_note: Voces: Maya (guía del museo) y Diego (visitante-reportero).
data.script: Maya: Welcome to the city museum! This first room is the oldest. … Diego: Wow, look at that enormous door! … Maya: It's made of wood from a ship that sailed here four hundred years ago. … Diego: And that shiny crown? … Maya: It's made of gold, with seven blue stones. … Diego: What's in the glass box? … Maya: A tiny silver whistle. Captains used it on stormy nights. … Diego: And this soft thing? … Maya: A blanket made of wool from mountain sheep. You can touch it! … Diego: Best museum ever!

data.script: Look at the picture. Listen and write the names. There is one example. … Diego: Who is that in the front of the school? The girl in the green shirt with a magnifying glass. … Maya: That is Maya. Maya is looking at something very small. … Diego: And who is the boy in the red shirt with a microphone? … Maya: That is Diego. Look, Diego is asking questions with his microphone. … Diego: And who is the girl with fair hair and a dark blue jacket? … Maya: That is Ingrid. Look, Ingrid is reading the plan for the day. … Diego: And who is the girl with long straight black hair and an orange shirt? … Maya: That is Aiko. Look, Aiko is reading a book. … Diego: And who is the girl with a red ponytail and freckles? … Maya: That is Iris. Look, Iris is drawing with chalk on the ground.
